canonicalStorage: Recorded PBDB ancestry below the previously documented Squamata path; no internal taxon ID or COL equivalence minted. Existing index and other record types preserved.
sourceInterpretation: eag/lag are occurrence-age brackets; selected outer envelope does not establish FAD/LAD, origin/extinction or continuous occupancy. Collection environment and preservation modes are collection-level fields, not whole-species ecological or specimen claims.
readerVisibleDelivery: Canonical prose prepared. PBDB atlas/profile/navigation compatibility mapping, generation, runtime delivery and publication pending content-phase handoff.
projectionMapping: Do not inject PBDB OIDs into COL catalogue profile descriptors. Convert/append the current catalogue-profile text pointers to PBDB atlas-profile using recorded external OIDs at content handoff, preserving existing atlas records and scientific uncertainties.

editorialPass.scope: Only current P5-47 paragraph markers and new neutral limitation headings. Source rows, percentages, ages, names, citations and maturity states retained.

timelineEndpointProvenance.scope: Named collection and occurrence ID identify one contributor to each selected outer bound. All ages and selected source rows retained.

collectionBoundaryCautions.scope: Database stratigraphic comment describes mixed Maastrichtian-Danian assemblage and proposed Maastrichtian lag deposit; broad Early Paleocene bracket does not establish species survival.
